paragraphs.text: And he showed me a river of water of life, bright as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἔδειξέν μοι ποταμὸν ὕδατος ζωῆς λαμπρὸν ὡς κρύσταλλον, ἐκπορευόμενον ἐκ τοῦ θρόνου τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ ἀρνίου
paragraphs.translit: Kai edeixen moi potamon hydatos zōēs lampron hōs krystallon, ekporeuomenon ek tou thronou tou theou kai tou arniou

paragraphs.text: in the midst of the street thereof. And on this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve [manner of] fruits, yielding its fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
paragraphs.original: ἐν μέσῳ τῆς πλατείας αὐτῆς· καὶ τοῦ ποταμοῦ ἐντεῦθεν καὶ ἐκεῖθεν ξύλον ζωῆς ποιοῦν καρποὺς δώδεκα, κατὰ μῆνα ἕκαστον ἀποδιδοῦν τὸν καρπὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰ φύλλα τοῦ ξύλου εἰς θεραπείαν τῶν ἐθνῶν.
paragraphs.translit: en mesō tēs plateias autēs· kai tou potamou enteuthen kai ekeithen xylon zōēs poioun karpous dōdeka, kata mēna hekaston apodidoun ton karpon autou, kai ta phylla tou xylou eis therapeian tōn ethnōn.

paragraphs.text: And there shall be no curse any more: and the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be therein: and his servants shall serve him;
paragraphs.original: καὶ πᾶν κατάθεμα οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι. καὶ ὁ θρόνος τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ ἀρνίου ἐν αὐτῇ ἔσται, καὶ οἱ δοῦλοι αὐτοῦ λατρεύσουσιν αὐτῷ,
paragraphs.translit: kai pan katathema ouk estai eti. kai ho thronos tou theou kai tou arniou en autē estai, kai hoi douloi autou latreusousin autō,

paragraphs.text: and they shall see his face; and his name [shall be] on their foreheads.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὄψονται τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῶν μετώπων αὐτῶν.
paragraphs.translit: kai opsontai to prosōpon autou, kai to onoma autou epi tōn metōpōn autōn.

paragraphs.text: And there shall be night no more; and they need no light of lamp, neither light of sun; for the Lord God shall give them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.
paragraphs.original: καὶ νὺξ οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι, καὶ οὐκ ἔχουσιν χρείαν φωτὸς λύχνου καὶ φῶς ἡλίου, ὅτι κύριος ὁ θεὸς φωτίσει ἐπʼ αὐτούς, καὶ βασιλεύσουσιν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων.
paragraphs.translit: kai nyx ouk estai eti, kai ouk echousin chreian phōtos lychnou kai phōs hēliou, hoti kyrios ho theos phōtisei epʼ autous, kai basileusousin eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn.

paragraphs.text: And he said unto me, These words are faithful and true: and the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent his angels to show unto his servants the things which must shortly come to pass.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ εἶπέν μοι· Οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι πιστοὶ καὶ ἀληθινοί, καὶ ὁ κύριος, ὁ θεὸς τῶν πνευμάτων τῶν προφητῶν, ἀπέστειλεν τὸν ἄγγελον αὐτοῦ δεῖξαι τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι ἐν τάχει·
paragraphs.translit: Kai eipen moi· Houtoi hoi logoi pistoi kai alēthinoi, kai ho kyrios, ho theos tōn pneumatōn tōn prophētōn, apesteilen ton angelon autou deixai tois doulois autou ha dei genesthai en tachei·

paragraphs.text: And behold, I come quickly. Blessed is he that keepeth the words of the prophecy of this book.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔρχομαι ταχύ· μακάριος ὁ τηρῶν τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου.
paragraphs.translit: kai idou erchomai tachy· makarios ho tērōn tous logous tēs prophēteias tou bibliou toutou.

paragraphs.text: And I John am he that heard and saw these things. And when I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel that showed me these things.
paragraphs.original: Κἀγὼ Ἰωάννης ὁ ἀκούων καὶ βλέπων ταῦτα. καὶ ὅτε ἤκουσα καὶ ἔβλεψα, ἔπεσα προσκυνῆσαι ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ποδῶν τοῦ ἀγγέλου τοῦ δεικνύοντός μοι ταῦτα.
paragraphs.translit: Kagō Iōannēs ho akouōn kai blepōn tauta. kai hote ēkousa kai eblepsa, epesa proskynēsai emprosthen tōn podōn tou angelou tou deiknyontos moi tauta.

paragraphs.text: And he saith unto me, See thou do it not: I am a fellow-servant with thee and with thy brethren the prophets, and with them that keep the words of this book: worship God.
paragraphs.original: καὶ λέγει μοι· Ὅρα μή· σύνδουλός σού εἰμι καὶ τῶν ἀδελφῶν σου τῶν προφητῶν καὶ τῶν τηρούντων τοὺς λόγους τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου· τῷ θεῷ προσκύνησον.
paragraphs.translit: kai legei moi· Hora mē· syndoulos sou eimi kai tōn adelphōn sou tōn prophētōn kai tōn tērountōn tous logous tou bibliou toutou· tō theō proskynēson.

paragraphs.text: And he saith unto me, Seal not up the words of the prophecy of this book; for the time is at hand.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ λέγει μοι· Μὴ σφραγίσῃς τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου, ὁ καιρὸς γὰρ ἐγγύς ἐστιν.
paragraphs.translit: Kai legei moi· Mē sphragisēs tous logous tēs prophēteias tou bibliou toutou, ho kairos gar engys estin.

paragraphs.text: He that is unrighteous, let him do unrighteousness still: and he that is filthy, let him be made filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him do righteousness still: and he that is holy, let him be made holy still.
paragraphs.original: ὁ ἀδικῶν ἀδικησάτω ἔτι, καὶ ὁ ῥυπαρὸς ῥυπαρευθήτω ἔτι, καὶ ὁ δίκαιος δικαιοσύνην ποιησάτω ἔτι, καὶ ὁ ἅγιος ἁγιασθήτω ἔτι.
paragraphs.translit: ho adikōn adikēsatō eti, kai ho rhyparos rhypareuthētō eti, kai ho dikaios dikaiosynēn poiēsatō eti, kai ho hagios hagiasthētō eti.

paragraphs.text: Behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to render to each man according as his work is.
paragraphs.original: Ἰδοὺ ἔρχομαι ταχύ, καὶ ὁ μισθός μου μετʼ ἐμοῦ, ἀποδοῦναι ἑκάστῳ ὡς τὸ ἔργον ἐστὶν αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Idou erchomai tachy, kai ho misthos mou metʼ emou, apodounai hekastō hōs to ergon estin autou.

paragraphs.text: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
paragraphs.original: ἐγὼ τὸ Ἄλφα καὶ τὸ Ὦ, ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος, ἡ ἀρχὴ καὶ τὸ τέλος.
paragraphs.translit: egō to Alpha kai to Ō, ho prōtos kai ho eschatos, hē archē kai to telos.

paragraphs.text: Blessed are they that wash their robes, that they may have the right [to come] to the tree of life, and my enter in by the gates into the city.
paragraphs.original: Μακάριοι οἱ πλύνοντες τὰς στολὰς αὐτῶν, ἵνα ἔσται ἡ ἐξουσία αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὸ ξύλον τῆς ζωῆς καὶ τοῖς πυλῶσιν εἰσέλθωσιν εἰς τὴν πόλιν.
paragraphs.translit: Makarioi hoi plynontes tas stolas autōn, hina estai hē exousia autōn epi to xylon tēs zōēs kai tois pylōsin eiselthōsin eis tēn polin.

paragraphs.text: Without are the dogs, and the sorcerers, and the fornicators, and the murderers, and the idolaters, and every one that loveth and maketh a lie.
paragraphs.original: ἔξω οἱ κύνες καὶ οἱ φάρμακοι καὶ οἱ πόρνοι καὶ οἱ φονεῖς καὶ οἱ εἰδωλολάτραι καὶ πᾶς φιλῶν καὶ ποιῶν ψεῦδος.
paragraphs.translit: exō hoi kynes kai hoi pharmakoi kai hoi pornoi kai hoi phoneis kai hoi eidōlolatrai kai pas philōn kai poiōn pseudos.

paragraphs.text: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things for the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, the bright, the morning star.
paragraphs.original: Ἐγὼ Ἰησοῦς ἔπεμψα τὸν ἄγγελόν μου μαρτυρῆσαι ὑμῖν ταῦτα ἐπὶ ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις. ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ῥίζα καὶ τὸ γένος Δαυίδ, ὁ ἀστὴρ ὁ λαμπρός, ὁ πρωϊνός.
paragraphs.translit: Egō Iēsous epempsa ton angelon mou martyrēsai hymin tauta epi tais ekklēsiais. egō eimi hē rhiza kai to genos Dauid, ho astēr ho lampros, ho prōinos.

paragraphs.text: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And he that heareth, let him say, Come. And he that is athirst, let him come: he that will, let him take the water of life freely.
paragraphs.original: καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ ἡ νύμφη λέγουσιν· Ἔρχου· καὶ ὁ ἀκούων εἰπάτω· Ἔρχου· καὶ ὁ διψῶν ἐρχέσθω, ὁ θέλων λαβέτω ὕδωρ ζωῆς δωρεάν.
paragraphs.translit: kai to pneuma kai hē nymphē legousin· Erchou· kai ho akouōn eipatō· Erchou· kai ho dipsōn erchesthō, ho thelōn labetō hydōr zōēs dōrean.

paragraphs.text: I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, if any man shall add unto them, God shall add unto him the plagues which are written in this book:
paragraphs.original: Μαρτυρῶ ἐγὼ παντὶ τῷ ἀκούοντι τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου· ἐάν τις ἐπιθῇ ἐπʼ αὐτά, ἐπιθήσει ὁ θεὸς ἐπʼ αὐτὸν τὰς πληγὰς τὰς γεγραμμένας ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τούτῳ·
paragraphs.translit: Martyrō egō panti tō akouonti tous logous tēs prophēteias tou bibliou toutou· ean tis epithē epʼ auta, epithēsei ho theos epʼ auton tas plēgas tas gegrammenas en tō bibliō toutō·

paragraphs.text: and if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐάν τις ἀφέλῃ ἀπὸ τῶν λόγων τοῦ βιβλίου τῆς προφητείας ταύτης, ἀφελεῖ ὁ θεὸς τὸ μέρος αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ ξύλου τῆς ζωῆς καὶ ἐκ τῆς πόλεως τῆς ἁγίας, τῶν γεγραμμένων ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τούτῳ.
paragraphs.translit: kai ean tis aphelē apo tōn logōn tou bibliou tēs prophēteias tautēs, aphelei ho theos to meros autou apo tou xylou tēs zōēs kai ek tēs poleōs tēs hagias, tōn gegrammenōn en tō bibliō toutō.

paragraphs.text: He who testifieth these things saith, Yea: I come quickly. Amen: come, Lord Jesus.
paragraphs.original: Λέγει ὁ μαρτυρῶν ταῦτα· Ναί· ἔρχομαι ταχύ. Ἀμήν· ἔρχου, κύριε Ἰησοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Legei ho martyrōn tauta· Nai· erchomai tachy. Amēn· erchou, kyrie Iēsou.

paragraphs.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with the saints. Amen.
paragraphs.original: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ μετὰ πάντων.
paragraphs.translit: Hē charis tou kyriou Iēsou meta pantōn.
